summary: Principles to explain or justify a layout choice. Each comes with what it changes on screen.

entries.what: People complete a shape that is cut: a card cut at the edge says there is more to scroll.
entries.avoid_when: Content that must be seen whole.
entries.build: Let the next card show by a quarter to a third.

entries.what: Dimming what is behind brings the important element forward.
entries.build: A scrim behind dialogs; the content behind loses contrast.

entries.what: Anything that looks like an ad is not seen.
entries.avoid_when: Coloured boxes in the sidebar or at the top of the page for key information.
entries.build: Put key information in the content flow, in the page's own style.

entries.what: A task expands to fill the time it is given: prefill what is known so it takes less.
entries.build: autocomplete attributes, defaults from the account, address lookup.

entries.what: Steps linked by a line or the same container are read as one sequence.
entries.build: A line or shared container between steps.

entries.what: More options slow the decision and can stop it.
entries.avoid_when: Expert tools where every option is needed (group them instead).
entries.build: Show a few options and a recommended one; the rest behind "more".

entries.what: Large and close targets are faster to reach.
entries.build: Main action large and near the thumb; 44 px targets at least.

entries.what: People expect a site to work like the ones they already know.
entries.avoid_when: When a new way is clearly better and taught.
entries.build: Logo top left goes home, cart top right, search with a magnifier.

entries.what: The item that differs is the one remembered.
entries.use_when: The recommended plan, the main action.
entries.avoid_when: Several items made different at once.
entries.build: One accent per screen for the main action.

sources.name: Laws of UX, Von Restorff effect

label.fr: Règle du pic et de la fin

entries.what: People judge an experience by its best moment and its end.
entries.build: Care for the success screen and the moment of first value.
